blocks.title: Radiant flux intensity
blocks.text: Radiant flux intensity (F) star ki woh electromagnetic energy hai jo har second, har square metre area par zameen ki surface tak pohanchti hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit! (Dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Agar zameen Sooraj se dugne faasle par hoti to us tak pohanchne wali dhoop sirf aik chauthai (1/4) tez hoti. Itni kam energy mein shayad zameen par zindagi shuru hi na hoti.

Yeh star ki kul luminosity ka bohat chhota hissa hota hai. Doosre lafzon mein, radiant flux intensity woh luminosity hai jo zameen ki surface par har square metre par aati hai. Agar star d faasle par ho to radiant flux intensity yeh hai:

blocks.prompt: Do stars raat ke aasman mein barabar roshan nazar aate hain, lekin aik doosre se 10 guna door hai. Kaun sa zyada luminous hai, aur kitna?
blocks.explanation: Door wala star. Barabar F ke liye L = 4πr²F, yani L, r² ke proportional hai. Faasla 10 guna hai, is liye luminosity 10² = 100 guna zyada hai.

blocks.text: Yahan L luminosity hai, aur r star se us jagah tak ka faasla hai jahan F napa ja raha hai (yahi upar wala d hai). Star ki luminosity constant rehti hai, is liye radiant flux intensity faasle ke saath inverse square law (faasle ke square ka ulta) follow karti hai, jaisa Fig. 21.1 mein dikhaya gaya hai. Is law ke mutabiq jab star ke centre se faasla dugna (r se 2r) ho to flux ki intensity pehle ki aik chauthai (1/4) reh jati hai. Isi tarah faasla teen guna (3r) ho to flux nau guna kam (1/9) ho jata hai, aur aage bhi yahi pattern chalta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke 4πr² "star ki surface ka area" hai. Yeh sahi nahi. F = L/4πr² mein r star se dekhne wale tak ka faasla hai, is liye 4πr² us imaginary sphere (khayali gend jaisa gola) ka area hai jis ka radius yeh faasla hai aur jis par star ki saari luminosity phail jati hai. Star ki apni surface ka area 4πR² hai, jahan R star ka radius hai (21.1 mein).

blocks.alt: Baen taraf aik point source (nuqte jaisa source) se seedhi lines phailti hain. r faasle par yeh aik square ke kinaron se guzarti hain; 2r par wahi lines chaar squares wala square gherti hain; 3r par nau squares wala. Neeche source se r, 2r aur 3r ke faasle dikhaye gaye hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.1: radiant flux intensity ke inverse-square law ka diagram (kitab ki Figure 21.1 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jo roshni r faasle par aik square se guzarti hai, wahi 2r par chaar squares aur 3r par nau squares par phail jati hai. Is liye 2r par har square ko 1/4 aur 3r par 1/9 roshni milti hai: flux faasle ke square ke ulat chalta hai (F ∝ 1/r²).

blocks.title: Example 21.2
blocks.problem: Aik star ki luminosity 4.50 × 10²⁶ W hai. Yeh aik planet se 1.40 × 10¹¹ m door hai. Us planet ki surface par star ki radiant flux intensity maloom karein.
steps: Diya gaya: L = 4.50 × 10²⁶ W, star se planet ka faasla r = 1.40 × 10¹¹ m; maloom karna hai F = ?
blocks.answer: F = 1.83 × 10³ W m⁻² (zameen par Sooraj ka flux taqreeban 1.4 × 10³ W m⁻² hai, yani yeh value usi range ki hai). Kitab ke hal mein 'Distance between Earth and the star' likha hai; sawal mein 'planet' hai, matlab wahi planet hai.

items: Radiant flux intensity F: har second, har square metre par pohanchne wali energy.
F = L/4πr² (21.2); r star se faasla hai, 4πr² imaginary sphere ka area.
Inverse square law: faasla dugna to flux 1/4, teen guna to 1/9.
